Submit Your Art for the Show!

Canary Cry News Talk is a podcast that provides therapeutic reflection and processing of our troubling world. As a way to process these unprecedented times together, we encourage producers to express the many themes, moments, and even jokes that appear on the show through art!

We love profiling the talents of our producers, it is a core resource for the ever growing Canary Cry Culture! While we make every attempt to credit and present all art submitted, submissions are not guranteed to appear on the next episode of the show.

Submit your art, and participate in the Value-for-Value model as a producer of the show!

CLICK HERE TO UPLOAD ART
